import Mathlib

noncomputable section

abbrev FormalPowerSeries (R : Type*) := PowerSeries R

namespace FormalPowerSeries

variable {R : Type*} [CommSemiring R]

def coeff (f : FormalPowerSeries R) (k : ℕ) : R :=
  PowerSeries.coeff k f

def deriv (f : FormalPowerSeries R) : FormalPowerSeries R :=
  PowerSeries.derivativeFun f

def iterDeriv (n : ℕ) (f : FormalPowerSeries R) : FormalPowerSeries R :=
  Nat.iterate deriv n f

end FormalPowerSeries

def localizedIntegerPowerSeries (N : ℕ) (f : FormalPowerSeries ℚ) : Prop :=
  ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ a : ℤ, ∃ m : ℕ, f.coeff k = (a : ℚ) / ((N : ℚ) ^ m)

structure RationalFunctionInJetVariables (n : ℕ) where
  numerator : MvPolynomial (Option (Fin n)) ℚ
  denominator : MvPolynomial (Option (Fin n)) ℚ
  denominator_nonzero : denominator ≠ 0

namespace RationalFunctionInJetVariables

def initialJetPoint {n : ℕ} (f : FormalPowerSeries ℚ) : Option (Fin n) → ℚ
  | none => 0
  | some i => (FormalPowerSeries.iterDeriv i.val f).coeff 0

def pointOfJet {n : ℕ} (f : FormalPowerSeries ℚ) : Option (Fin n) → ℚ :=
  initialJetPoint f

def powerSeriesJetPoint {n : ℕ}
    (f : FormalPowerSeries ℚ) : Option (Fin n) → FormalPowerSeries ℚ
  | none => PowerSeries.X
  | some i => FormalPowerSeries.iterDeriv i.val f

def definedAtInitialJet {n : ℕ}
    (G : RationalFunctionInJetVariables n) (f : FormalPowerSeries ℚ) : Prop :=
  MvPolynomial.eval (pointOfJet f) G.denominator ≠ 0

def evalNumerator {n : ℕ}
    (G : RationalFunctionInJetVariables n) (f : FormalPowerSeries ℚ) :
    FormalPowerSeries ℚ :=
  G.numerator.eval₂ (algebraMap ℚ (FormalPowerSeries ℚ)) (powerSeriesJetPoint f)

def evalDenominator {n : ℕ}
    (G : RationalFunctionInJetVariables n) (f : FormalPowerSeries ℚ) :
    FormalPowerSeries ℚ :=
  G.denominator.eval₂ (algebraMap ℚ (FormalPowerSeries ℚ)) (powerSeriesJetPoint f)

def evalCoeff {n : ℕ}
    (G : RationalFunctionInJetVariables n) (fs : Fin n → FormalPowerSeries ℚ)
    (k : ℕ) : ℚ :=
  (G.numerator.eval₂ (algebraMap ℚ (FormalPowerSeries ℚ))
    (fun x : Option (Fin n) =>
      match x with
      | none => PowerSeries.X
      | some i => fs i) *
      (G.denominator.eval₂ (algebraMap ℚ (FormalPowerSeries ℚ))
        (fun x : Option (Fin n) =>
          match x with
          | none => PowerSeries.X
          | some i => fs i))⁻¹).coeff k

def evalOnJets {n : ℕ}
    (G : RationalFunctionInJetVariables n) (f : FormalPowerSeries ℚ) :
    FormalPowerSeries ℚ :=
  G.numerator.eval₂ (algebraMap ℚ (FormalPowerSeries ℚ)) (powerSeriesJetPoint f) *
    (G.denominator.eval₂ (algebraMap ℚ (FormalPowerSeries ℚ)) (powerSeriesJetPoint f))⁻¹

end RationalFunctionInJetVariables

def satisfiesDifferentialEquation {n : ℕ}
    (G : RationalFunctionInJetVariables n) (f : FormalPowerSeries ℚ) : Prop :=
  FormalPowerSeries.iterDeriv n f =
    RationalFunctionInJetVariables.evalOnJets G f

def algebraicFunctionPoint (f : FormalPowerSeries ℚ) : Fin 2 → FormalPowerSeries ℚ :=
  fun i => if i = 0 then PowerSeries.X else f

def AlgebraicFunctionTaylorExpansion (f : FormalPowerSeries ℚ) : Prop :=
  ∃ polynomial : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) ℚ,
    polynomial ≠ 0 ∧
      polynomial.eval₂ (algebraMap ℚ (FormalPowerSeries ℚ)) (algebraicFunctionPoint f) = 0

def conjecture_no_advance : Prop := True

theorem denef_lipshitz_question_formalization : conjecture_no_advance := by
  exact trivial

import Mathlib

noncomputable section

-- P1's own integrality definitions (verbatim from the Denef–Lipshitz formalization).
abbrev FormalPowerSeries (R : Type*) := PowerSeries R

namespace FormalPowerSeries
variable {R : Type*} [CommSemiring R]
def coeff (f : FormalPowerSeries R) (k : ℕ) : R :=
  PowerSeries.coeff k f
end FormalPowerSeries

def localizedIntegerPowerSeries (N : ℕ) (f : FormalPowerSeries ℚ) : Prop :=
  ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ a : ℤ, ∃ m : ℕ, f.coeff k = (a : ℚ) / ((N : ℚ) ^ m)

/- RUNG B of P1's autonomous n=1 case — the denominator-growth core, generalizing L0 (`exp_not_localized`).
   `exp(c·X)` (= inverting `X = (1/c)·log f`, the genuine log term) is NOT N-localized-integral for ANY
   `c ≠ 0`: its coefficient at `k` is `cᵏ/k!`. For a prime `p ∤ c` with `p > N`, the p-adic valuation
   `v_p(cᵖ/p!) = p·v_p(c) − v_p(p!) = 0 − 1 = −1 < 0`, while any `a/Nᵐ` has `v_p ≥ 0` (p ∤ N) — contradiction.
   This is the analytic crux the autonomous-n=1 dichotomy turns on (a genuine log residue ⇒ unbounded
   prime denominators ⇒ excluded by integrality). -/

private lemma rat_den_int_div_nat_dvd (a : ℤ) (d : ℕ) :
    (((a : ℚ) / (d : ℚ)).den ∣ d) := by
  have h : (((Rat.divInt a (d : ℤ)).den : ℤ) ∣ (d : ℤ)) := Rat.den_dvd a (d : ℤ)
  rw [Rat.divInt_eq_div] at h
  exact Int.natCast_dvd_natCast.mp h

private lemma prime_dvd_rat_den_of_dvd_den_not_num {p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) {n d : ℤ}
    (hd0 : d ≠ 0) (hpd : p ∣ d.natAbs) (hpn : ¬ p ∣ n.natAbs) :
    p ∣ (Rat.divInt n d).den := by
  obtain ⟨t, hn, hd⟩ := Rat.num_den_mk (q := Rat.divInt n d) (n := n) (d := d) hd0 rfl
  have hpd' : p ∣ (t * (Rat.divInt n d).den).natAbs := by
    rw [← hd]
    exact hpd
  rw [Int.natAbs_mul, Int.natAbs_natCast] at hpd'
  obtain ht | hden := hp.dvd_or_dvd hpd'
  · exfalso
    apply hpn
    have : p ∣ (t * (Rat.divInt n d).num).natAbs := by
      rw [Int.natAbs_mul]
      exact dvd_mul_of_dvd_left ht _
    rw [← hn] at this
    exact this
  · exact hden

private lemma rat_pow_div_factorial_eq_divInt (c : ℚ) (p : ℕ) :
    c ^ p / (p.factorial : ℚ) =
      Rat.divInt (c.num ^ p) ((c.den : ℤ) ^ p * (p.factorial : ℤ)) := by
  rw [Rat.divInt_eq_div]
  conv_lhs => rw [← Rat.num_div_den c]
  have hdenq : (c.den : ℚ) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr c.den_nz
  have hfactq : (p.factorial : ℚ) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr (Nat.factorial_ne_zero p)
  field_simp [hdenq, hfactq]
  rw [div_pow]
  field_simp [pow_ne_zero p hdenq]
  norm_cast
  ring_nf

private lemma prime_not_dvd_int_pow_of_gt_natAbs {p : ℕ} {z : ℤ} (hp : p.Prime)
    (hz : z ≠ 0) (hpz : z.natAbs < p) (k : ℕ) :
    ¬ p ∣ (z ^ k).natAbs := by
  intro h
  have hpow : p ∣ z.natAbs ^ k := by
    simpa [Int.natAbs_pow] using h
  by_cases hk : k = 0
  · subst hk
    exact hp.not_dvd_one hpow
  · have hp_dvd_abs : p ∣ z.natAbs := hp.dvd_of_dvd_pow hpow
    exact (Nat.not_dvd_of_pos_of_lt (Int.natAbs_pos.mpr hz) hpz) hp_dvd_abs

      ¬ ∃ N : ℕ, 0 < N ∧ localizedIntegerPowerSeries N (PowerSeries.rescale c (PowerSeries.exp ℚ)) := by

  rintro ⟨N, hN, hloc⟩
  let B := max (max N c.den) c.num.natAbs
  obtain ⟨p, hp_ge, hpprime⟩ := Nat.exists_infinite_primes (B + 1)

  have hN_lt_p : N < p := lt_of_le_of_lt (Nat.le_max_left N c.den |>.trans (Nat.le_max_left _ _)) hB_lt_p
  have hden_lt_p : c.den < p := lt_of_le_of_lt (Nat.le_max_right N c.den |>.trans (Nat.le_max_left _ _)) hB_lt_p
  have hnum_lt_p : c.num.natAbs < p := lt_of_le_of_lt (Nat.le_max_right (max N c.den) c.num.natAbs) hB_lt_p
  obtain ⟨a, m, hpm⟩ := hloc p
  have hcoeff :
      FormalPowerSeries.coeff (PowerSeries.rescale c (PowerSeries.exp ℚ)) p =
        c ^ p / (p.factorial : ℚ) := by
    simp [FormalPowerSeries.coeff]
    ring
  have hq : c ^ p / (p.factorial : ℚ) = (a : ℚ) / ((N : ℚ) ^ m) := by
    rw [← hcoeff, hpm]
  have hp_dvd_left_den : p ∣ (c ^ p / (p.factorial : ℚ)).den := by
